text:
WINNERS STUDY, 2026-10-07
Whole US market 2024-10-08 to 2026-10-07, stocks that later collapsed included. 5134 times a stock rose 30%+ within 20 sessions.

WHAT WINNERS LOOKED LIKE THE DAY BEFORE (how much more common than on an ordinary day)
- opened 3% or more above the previous close: 5% of winners vs 3% of all days (1.9x)
- up 50% or more in 6 months: 21% of winners vs 12% of all days (1.8x)
- volume at least twice its 50 day average: 8% of winners vs 5% of all days (1.7x)
- quiet base: last 10 days’ moves under 75% of the 50 day norm: 13% of winners vs 10% of all days (1.3x)
- thinly followed: under 20M USD traded a day: 37% of winners vs 33% of all days (1.1x)
Common among winners is not the same as a buy signal: most stocks with these looks do not become winners. So each look was tested as a buy rule:

TESTED AS BUY RULES (buy next open, stop 2 daily moves, sell after 10 sessions; chosen on the older year, judged on the newer year from 2026-03-11, 0.8% cost)
NOT PROVEN: quiet base: last 10 days’ moves under 75% of the 50 day norm + opened 3% or more above the previous close
  987 trades, 49% won, average +1.0% a trade, profit factor 1.18. profit factor 1.18; no better than the S&P 500 over the same days
REJECTED: quiet base: last 10 days’ moves under 75% of the 50 day norm + S&P 500 above its 50 day average
  6501 trades, 35% won, average -1.3% a trade, profit factor 0.69. lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost
REJECTED: quiet base: last 10 days’ moves under 75% of the 50 day norm
  7457 trades, 37% won, average -1.2% a trade, profit factor 0.71. lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost
REJECTED: up 4% to 20% on the day + quiet base: last 10 days’ moves under 75% of the 50 day norm
  1599 trades, 42% won, average -0.7% a trade, profit factor 0.88. lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost
REJECTED: closed in the top fifth of the day’s range + quiet base: last 10 days’ moves under 75% of the 50 day norm
  3869 trades, 38% won, average -0.9% a trade, profit factor 0.78. lost money in the newer half even at the lowest cost
Buying a random stock the same way: 36251 trades, 43% won, average -0.6% a trade, profit factor 0.83.

RESULT: no winner pattern passed the fair test. Nothing to act on. The study repeats every week as new days come in.
About 2 years, one market climate. Daily prices only. Research, not an order. Not financial advice, not a halal ruling.
